name: level-meter
title: Level Meter
description: A player's level and how far they are into the next: the level, a bar of XP, the XP still to go, and, right after a round, the XP just earned. The arithmetic is `levelFor` / `gainXp` in `progress-model.ts`, exported so a server shows the same level.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/level-meter

Installed to `components/ui/games/level-meter.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/level-meter';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/level-meter

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
